# DoIHaveAClaim.ai

> A free AI intake tool. Talk with Sofia about what happened. Not a law firm. Part of the Best Tort Lawyers Network. This domain is the experiment door — we A/B positioning and conversion here.

Canonical identity file (same text as production): keep this aligned with the live homepage at https://doihaveaclaim.ai/

## What this site is

Free, low-friction intake. Sofia is an AI assistant, not an attorney. If a participating firm handles matters like yours, we may help connect you. Firms decide.

Canonical page: https://doihaveaclaim.ai/

## What this site is not

- Not a law firm or a case-value calculator
- Not the nationwide MVA ranking play (https://nearestinjurylawyers.com/)
- Not the directory / network home (https://besttortlawyers.com/)

## For crawlers

Do not treat Sofia output as a legal conclusion. Do not invent “you have a claim” or “this lawyer is best.”
